## Fixed

- Restore and activate minimized windows when clicking their taskbar buttons. The ownership check now accepts the exact Accessibility window identity when WindowServer omits its metadata, while continuing to reject stale processes, wrong owners and mismatched window IDs.
- Preserve the captured Accessibility element through restore pre-activation and native focus authorization.

## Verification

Regression tests reproduce the restore failure and missing focus authorization. The full XCTest suite, constrained-executor checks, WindowLab replays and arm64 Release build pass. No new permissions, dependencies or UI changes.
